methods.label: Pair consecutive terms
methods.explanation: Group the terms in pairs: \((1-2)+(3-4)+\cdots+(99-100)\). There are 50 groups, each equal to \(-1\), so the sum is \(-50\).
methods.levelReason: Pairing adjacent signed terms uses elementary counting and Grade 7 addition laws; no sequence formula is needed.
